title: Safe area
description: The corner the operating system keeps for its own window buttons, so nothing of the app stands under them.

getSide.label: Side
getSide.hint: Left holds macOS's three buttons, right holds Windows' three.

getPlatform.label: Platform
getPlatform.hint: The system the app runs on; a corner the system leaves free keeps only a narrow edge.

getDrawsSystemButtons.label: Draw the system's buttons
getDrawsSystemButtons.hint: Only for a design: the system draws its own buttons over this space.
